articles.title: Defence capability bristling as Rs 2.4 lakh crore fresh deals get nod
articles.summary: India's Defence Ministry has approved major procurement deals to significantly upgrade military capabilities. The acquisitions include unmanned strike aircraft, advanced S-400 air defence systems, new transport aircraft, and modern artillery guns. Valued at over 2.3..., this strategic move aims to bolster national security and operational readiness, reflecting a strong commitment to defence modernization and enhancing India's combat power.

articles.title: Defence ministry inks Rs 445cr deal for Tunguska missile systems with Russia, signs Rs 413cr P8I jet maintenance contract with Boeing
articles.summary: India's Defence Ministry has finalized two significant deals: a Rs 445 crore acquisition for Tunguska missile systems with Russia, enhancing air defence capabilities, and a Rs 413 crore maintenance contract with Boeing for its P8I maritime surveillance aircraft fleet. These strategic agreements underscore India's ongoing efforts to modernize its armed forces and strengthen defence preparedness.

articles.title: WATCH: Trump Calls the Strait of Hormuz the “Strait of Trump”, Trolls Dead Iranian Leaders During Summit with Business Leaders
articles.summary: President Trump mocked Iranian leaders at a summit, criticizing their military's state and controversially renaming the Strait of Hormuz. This incident underscores rising US-Iran tensions and the strategic importance of the Middle East, particularly maritime security in vital waterways, a key focus for global defence strategy and international relations.

articles.title: Jeremy Adams Tells Us Just Who The Shiver Are In Emperor Aquaman
articles.summary: Writer Jeremy Adams is set to elaborate on the mysterious group known as 'The Shiver' within the ongoing 'Emperor Aquaman' comic book storyline. This narrative development in DC Comics promises to unveil their origins and significance, ultimately connecting their story to the powerful cosmic villain, Darkseid.
